decisions.reason: The cited later proposition presupposed the complexification bracket whose well-definedness the definition was trying to establish, so it was circular at the defining step. A direct tensor-coordinate construction now proves well-definedness and Jacobi without that proposition.

Cartan's criterion requires characteristic zero, which the fact restatement omitted. The actual real and complex fields already have characteristic zero, so the proof's application was valid after restoring the missing hypothesis.

The original orbit argument established ambient conjugacy but did not prove that an abstract real-form isomorphism gives such a conjugacy. Complexifying the real isomorphism and composing with the two canonical scalar-extension maps supplies the required ambient automorphism.

Self-adjointness of ad_X for X in p was essential to the simultaneous-diagonalisation step and was not stated by the cited bracket-sign interface. Invariance of the Killing form now gives the adjoint identity directly, with the spectral dependencies declared.

The cited conjugacy theorem was stated for a noncompact symmetric pair, while the definition only supplied a Lie algebra with Cartan involution. The repair constructs the adjoint group of the noncompact semisimple summand and verifies the theorem's group hypotheses before using conjugacy.

Fact L1 jointly cites the general/special linear Lie-group example, whose interface explicitly defines sl_n(R), and the special-linear definition for the displayed matrices and brackets. Together those suppliers license the real sl_2(R) computation exactly as used.

H_0 lies in a rather than its dual, so it cannot itself be a linear functional on a. The intended positivity condition is the linear functional on a* given by lambda mapping to lambda(H_0), and the definition now says this correctly.

The Cayley-transform theorem did not state the maximality criteria attributed to it. The definition itself remained meaningful, but its support paragraph was inaccurate; the repair separates the existence supplier from the Cayley-transform comparison and removes the unsupported attribution.

The differing Killing-form signatures are the invariant that proves the two real forms nonisomorphic, but the cited Cartan-subalgebra proposition supplied no such values. The repaired fact cites the dedicated sl_2 Killing-form computation that establishes the required signatures.

The compact/split definitions require a finite-dimensional semisimple complex ambient algebra, and the original proof never established semisimplicity of sl_2(C). The repair computes a nondegenerate Killing Gram matrix and invokes Cartan's criterion before applying those definitions.

The supplier's map has the abstract coroot alpha dual in its Euclidean domain and sends it to h_alpha; the original restatement reversed this arrow and was ill-typed. Correcting the direction restores the cited normalization without changing the Chevalley construction.

The earlier calculation only found the centralizer of a inside p, not the full zero restricted-root space in g. A direct entrywise commutator calculation now shows every matrix commuting with all trace-zero diagonal matrices is diagonal, so g^0=a.

The global differential formula for a general Lie-group exponential was not licensed by smoothness and its derivative at zero, yet invertibility of that differential was essential. The repair derives the formula through the faithful adjoint representation and the ordinary finite-dimensional matrix exponential.

Nonabelianness of p alone did not exclude a theta-stable Cartan with a two-dimensional split part, because abelianness of h intersect p was not supplied. The repair directly shows that containing all of p forces the Cartan to contain [p,p] and hence all nonnilpotent sl_2(R).

The Satake dependency classifies real forms by realized Satake-diagram classes and supplies no realization theorem for every formal class. The classification statement now consistently says realized Vogan and Satake classes, preserving exactly what the cited interfaces prove.

The symbol h_B was neither locally defined nor supplied by the cited example, so the asserted equality involving it was untyped. Replacing it by the explicitly defined line R K_0 preserves the compact Cartan comparison and removes the unsupported notation.

With the library's zero-based Chevalley-Eilenberg convention, the displayed formula was the negative of dc. Since vanishing is invariant under an overall sign, the cocycle conclusion survived, but the fact and the cyclic-sum comparison required correction.

The cited orbit-orthogonal lemma supplied only kernel and image identities, not the Hamiltonian-vector-field equation used to identify characteristic directions. The repair declares and cites the moment-map component identity that gives X_{mu^xi}=-xi_M under the library convention.

Without positive coprime weights, the weighted circle action can have a generic finite kernel, so the two axis stabilizers are not the claimed isolated orbifold orders. The example now assumes positive coprime weights, making the action effective and the stabilizer calculation correct.

The proof compares fundamental Cartans and positive systems only for one fixed Cartan involution and contains no independence argument for changing that involution. Narrowing the title and statement to fixed theta makes the claim exactly match the established scope.

The Cayley theorem supplied real inner conjugacy, not conjugacy by the compact automorphism group required in the comparison proof. The repair derives fixed-theta K-conjugacy by conjugating maximal abelian split parts and then maximal tori in their compact centralizer.

The universal existence proof began by choosing a Cartan subalgebra and a base of roots without any dependency establishing those objects for an arbitrary complex semisimple algebra. The missing existence theorems are now explicit dependencies and are invoked before the Chevalley construction.

A positive quadratic form does not by itself make an arbitrary endomorphism self-adjoint, while the square-root supplier requires both properties. The proof had already established self-adjointness of its particular operator, so restoring that hypothesis makes the cited use valid.

Properness of the action was deduced from compactness of U(k), but the cited unitary-group interface did not assert compactness. The repair proves U(k) is closed and bounded in its finite-dimensional matrix space and invokes Heine-Borel before using compactness.

Neither cited interface established that the hat-map identification carries the Lie bracket to cross product or the adjoint and coadjoint actions to rotations. Direct matrix multiplication and rotation equivariance now prove all three identities before the KKS computation uses them.

The phrase claiming an exhaustive list of low-rank coincidences was false because it omitted sp_4(R) isomorphic to so(3,2) and the compact sp(2) isomorphic to so(5). The text now presents a nonexhaustive list and includes both missing B_2/C_2 real forms.

The closed-subgroup supplier gave embedded subgroup structure but not the exponential characterization attributed to it. The proof already obtains the Lie algebra by differentiating the defining matrix equations and proves the converse with matrix exponentials, so the unsupported restatement was removed.

Under the stated identification the indivisible roots that admit doubling map to plus or minus e_i, whereas their doubled roots map to plus or minus 2e_i. The statement and verification now distinguish Psi from 2Psi correctly.

reviews.reason: Under the canonical real-linear identification with g_0 direct-sum g_0, the proposed tensor bracket has an explicit coordinate formula. Complex bilinearity, skew symmetry, and Jacobi follow directly, so no circular supplier remains.

The repaired Cartan-criterion fact explicitly assumes characteristic zero, and both R and C satisfy it. The scalar-extension trace calculation then proves the equivalence of Killing-form nondegeneracy as claimed.

For any real isomorphism f, the map e_0' composed with f tensor identity composed with e_0 inverse is a complex automorphism of the ambient g carrying one real form to the other. This closes the ordinary-isomorphism class bijection.

Killing invariance and theta X=-X give B_theta([X,Y],Z)=B_theta(Y,[X,Z]), so ad_X is self-adjoint. The real spectral theorem and commuting-family theorem therefore justify the simultaneous eigenspace argument used in the conjugacy proof.

Removing compact ideals and taking Aut(g_nc)^0 gives a connected centerless group with Lie algebra ad(g_nc); conjugation by theta supplies its global involution. The symmetric-pair conjugacy theorem now applies and makes the dimension independent of the choice.

The combined citations in L1 supply both the real matrix Lie algebra sl_2(R) and the displayed basis matrices with their commutators. The subsequent nilpotence and Killing-signature arguments are licensed and logically complete, so no edit was warranted.

The repaired definition correctly places H_0 in a and the evaluation map lambda to lambda(H_0) in the dual of a*. Its nonvanishing off the chosen hyperplanes gives the stated positive/negative partition and nilpotent sum.

The compact and split parts are precisely the theta eigenspace intersections of a theta-stable Cartan. Existence is now attributed to its actual theorem, while Cayley transforms are used only for the comparison statement their interface supports.

The dedicated sl_2 Killing-form example supplies the signs used for su(2) and sl_2(R). Since Killing signature is invariant under real Lie-algebra isomorphism, the compact and split real forms cannot be isomorphic despite sharing the same complexification.

The displayed Killing Gram matrix on E,F,H has nonzero determinant, so Cartan's characteristic-zero criterion proves sl_2(C) semisimple. The compact and split definitions now state their ambient hypotheses and apply legitimately to the two verified real forms.

The corrected interface sends the abstract coroot alpha dual to h_alpha under lambda mapping to H_lambda. This has the right domain and codomain and supplies the normalization used in the integral real structure-constant construction.

For a matrix commuting with every trace-zero diagonal H, each off-diagonal entry is killed by some difference h_i-h_j and must vanish. Trace zero then identifies the entire centralizer with a, completing the zero-space and restricted-root decomposition.

Applying the faithful differential of Ad to exp(-X)exp(X+tS) reduces differentiation to the convergent matrix-exponential series and yields the integral dexp formula. The subsequent spectral argument proves its required invertibility without assuming a series for the group exponential.

If a theta-stable Cartan had two-dimensional split part, it would contain all of p and hence [p,p]=R K_0, so it would equal sl_2(R), which is not nilpotent. Therefore the exhibited one-dimensional split part is maximal and the extremal comparison is valid.

Every classification arrow now lands in realized diagram classes, exactly the image asserted by the Vogan and Satake suppliers. No unstated realization criterion for arbitrary decorated diagrams is used in the repaired proof.

The compact Cartan line is now written directly as R K_0 using the already defined matrix K_0. Its Killing sign differs from the split line R H, so automorphism invariance of the Killing form still proves nonconjugacy.

The repaired F7 matches the library's zero-based Chevalley-Eilenberg signs. The Jacobi cyclic sum is explicitly identified as minus dc, and because the cyclic sum vanishes the claimed two-cocycle conclusion follows with the correct convention.

The declared moment-map component identity gives X_{mu^xi}=-xi_M with the chosen Hamiltonian sign. Combined with the regular-level tangent kernel and orbit-orthogonal identities, it proves the characteristic kernel is exactly the tangent orbit distribution.

For positive coprime weights k and l the generic stabilizer is trivial, while the coordinate axes have stabilizers of orders k and l. The quotient description as a weighted projective line with precisely those orbifold points is therefore correct.

The title and statement now fix theta, matching the proof's use of conjugacy of fundamental theta-stable Cartans and changes of positive system. No conclusion about independence under a different Cartan involution is asserted without proof.

Maximal abelian split parts are K-conjugate, and after aligning them the compact parts are maximal tori in the compact centralizer and hence conjugate there. This proves the fixed-theta compact conjugacy actually needed to compare the two diagram constructions.

The proof now first invokes existence of a Cartan subalgebra and then existence of a positive system and simple-root base. With those universal prerequisites supplied, the Chevalley real-span construction proves existence and the diagram argument proves uniqueness.

The operator used in the construction is explicitly proved positive-definite and self-adjoint before the square-root lemma is invoked. Its positive self-adjoint square root therefore exists and the subsequent polar construction of the compatible invariant J is valid.

The unitary equations define a closed subset of the finite-dimensional matrix space and every unitary matrix has fixed Frobenius norm, so Heine-Borel makes U(k) compact. Its action is consequently proper, completing the reduction hypotheses.

The hat map is bijective onto skew matrices, direct multiplication gives [hat v,hat w]=hat(v cross w), and SO(3) equivariance gives the rotation adjoint action. Orthogonality transfers this to the coadjoint action, licensing the orbit and KKS calculations.

The low-rank paragraph is no longer presented as exhaustive and now includes the split and compact B_2/C_2 coincidences sp_4(R) with so(3,2) and sp(2) with so(5). The remaining family descriptions and equivalence qualifications are unchanged.

Differentiating A^T I A=I and det A=1 at the identity gives the stated Lie algebra, and exponentiating a matrix satisfying the infinitesimal relation proves the converse directly. Compactness of SO(n) is separately proved by closedness and boundedness.

The corrected statement sends the roots in Psi to plus or minus e_i and the doubled roots in 2Psi to plus or minus 2e_i. This agrees with the BC_r model and correctly exhibits a nonreduced restricted root system.
